Il apparaît sur votre mur familial.' — no occurrence of 'On ne le réécrit pas une deuxième fois' in the codebase (grep) and none in the rendered DOM. Could not observe the 'Tous les épisodes sont terminés' terminal state because the fresh account still has 'Mes qualités' pending. Cancel works.

critical_code_review_comments: session/[episodeId].tsx line 973: locked-card copy is exactly the requested wording ('Vous avez déjà partagé votre mot de fin pour cet épisode. Il apparaît sur votre mur familial.'). No occurrence of 'On ne le réécrit' anywhere in the codebase — clean removal.

CategorizeGame component (session/[episodeId].tsx lines ~750-870) implements onReachEnd correctly: (a) handleStart called with total<=1 triggers onReachEnd immediately (edge case), (b) handleNext triggers onReachEnd only when nextIdx === total - 1 (situation 6 index 5), (c) Suivant button hidden via `!isLast` on the last situation, (d) 'Nous avons terminé' is gated at the ParentGameContent level (hidesTerminate + reachedEnd), which we observed working correctly.
hidesTerminate correctly extended to include 'categorize' (line 512): const hidesTerminate = gameType === 'letters' || gameType === 'ranking' || gameType === 'categorize';
admin.html editEpisode() correctly branches on g.type === 'categorize' (lines 957-963), populates all 3 labels + situations textarea, and toggles the display of #categorize-fields. Verified in DOM.

Backend accepts mini_game.data as Dict[str, Any] with no schema change — episode 6a79b6807fc84413b7b24996 persisted the categorize payload intact (verified via GET /api/episodes/{id}: 6 situations + 3 labels present).
